# AGENTS.md — GitHub Actions

Run jobs on Windows runners (`windows-*` labels) under native `pwsh`. The pull-request `windows` job is the deliberate exception: it runs Windows Node under Wine on hosted Linux and blocks `all checks passed`. Native build and process checks also block the aggregate; native coverage and observational checks report independently. Native jobs use `windows-2025`, or the self-hosted `[self-hosted, alego-win-ci, windows]` pool under `ALEGO_CI_FAILOVER_WINDOWS=selfhosted`. `ci.yml` is pull-request-only. `ci-master.yml` handles `main` pushes and manual dispatches; it owns the serial Windows and Linux self-hosted standby jobs, Wine cache seeder, and manual runner benchmarks. Standby jobs require `ALEGO_SELF_HOSTED_STANDBY_ENABLED=true`; configure and validate the pools before enabling them or selecting failover. See the [failover runbook](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-07-26-ci-failover-runbook.md).
